name: @dialstack/sdk-dev
//name: Not "@dialstack/sdk". This root is a private tooling workspace — jest for every package, storybook, eslint, prettier — and keeping the published name here made npm link node_modules/@dialstack/sdk, so a stray `from "@dialstack/sdk"` anywhere in the monorepo silently resolved to a package with no exports map instead of failing. The published packages are js/, react/, server/ and webrtc/. @dialstack/sdk stays on npm, frozen, for anyone already installing it.
//private: Never published. Its version is not a release version; the four packages below carry their own.
description: Official JavaScript SDK for DialStack - Business Voice for Vertical SaaS
author: DialStack

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix js && npm run build --prefix webrtc && npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix react
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist js/dist webrtc/dist server/dist react/dist
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix js && npm run typecheck --prefix webrtc && npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix react && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.check:package: npm run check:package --prefix js && npm run check:package --prefix webrtc && npm run check:package --prefix server && npm run check:package --prefix react
scripts.lint: eslint src scripts js/src react/src webrtc/src server/src native/src
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src scripts js/src react/src webrtc/src server/src native/src --fix
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts js/src react/src webrtc/src server/src native/src
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts js/src react/src webrtc/src server/src native/src
scripts.precommit: npm run format && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:e2e:all: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:firefox && npm run test:e2e:webkit

//engines: The tooling root, not a published package — this is the floor for running the repo's own scripts, not a consumer contract. 22.18 because check:deps executes a .ts file directly and Node strips types unflagged only from there; the .nvmrc pins 24, which is what CI uses. The four published packages declare their own, lower floors.
